newsitem.headline: First Union Real Estate Q1 shr profit $0.05.

text.p: Net income applicable to shares of
Net income applicable to shares of
1. In January 1997, the trust sold a shopping center in Wilkesboro, N.C., for $9 million in cash resulting in a loss of $4.9 million.

In February 1996, the trust sold two office buildings in Cleveland for $1.8 million in cash and a $7 million mortgage note, which was subsequently repaid, resulting in a loss of $5.6 million. Both losses had been previously recognized during the fourth quarter of 1995 as part of a $14 million unrealized loss on carrying value of assets identified for disposition.

2. The amount of funds from operations is calculated in accordance with the National Association of Real Estate Investment Trusts definition of FFO, both before and after the preferred dividend, plus noncash charges for depreciation and amortization of both First Union and the joint venture interest. FFO for 1996 has been restated to correspond with the NAREIT definition.
Full company name is First Union Real Estate Investments.
